scope_note: Road outer tires with a current 700C width of 25-35 mm, or 20-40 mm with wet-traction evidence: mainland-China and Taiwan brands found in Chinese marketplaces and XHS, plus leading international lines sold in Asia, Europe and North America. Inner tubes and gravel, MTB and city tires are outside the comparison. This is the discovered roster, not every tire made.

routes.name: Bicycle Rolling Resistance road list
routes.summary: 183 road tires with public lab figures; no mainland-Chinese brand is listed.

routes.name: Xiaohongshu search
routes.summary: Ten searches (domestic road tires, top domestic tires, Chaoyang/ARISUN, domestic tubeless, JILUER, wet grip, Innova, CST, Kenda, new 2026 tires) and 25 opened posts in one sequential browser session; repeated results showed saturation for domestic brands.

routes.name: Taobao and Tmall
routes.summary: Brand facet for the road-tire query, tubeless listings, official-store listings (Chaoyang, ARISUN, Continental, Michelin, Giant) and dealer or shop listings for CST, Kenda, JILUER, Innova, Maxxis, Pirelli and Vittoria. Follow-up the same day: 14 exact-model searches for the unresolved Chinese and Taiwanese rows, 12 listings opened, six maker-catalog searches (Chaoyang, ARISUN, Kenda, CST, Innova, JILUER) and three broad domestic queries; no further mainland brand with its own road tire was found, and unnamed generic listings were not added.

routes.name: Maker catalogs
routes.summary: Road ranges from Continental (global, US, German), Pirelli (global and UK), Michelin (UK racing and endurance), Vittoria (international store), Goodyear (US store), Maxxis (US), Kenda (US shop), Specialized (US store), Panaracer (USA store and global site), IRC (US site), CADEX (US store), Giant (UK, US and Australian stores), Hutchinson (global site) and Schwalbe (North American road category and schwalbe.com variant pages, read as server pages because the browser rendered them blank). Continental's Grand Prix 4-Season page has no size table, so a US retailer listing is recorded as seller claims; the CADEX Aero tires have no CADEX product page, so independent lab pages record them.

routes.name: Brand identity checks
routes.summary: Web searches for ZC Rubber/ARISUN, JILUER, Innova and CARNOS; company pages for Panaracer, IRC and Hutchinson.
